title: Container Bookings: no-show fee and no-show threshold by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, the no-show fee charged when the vessel departs with nothing gated in, and the number of no-show fees in the customer's trailing 90 days at which new requests for that tier are declined.

## What each setting means
- **No-show fee**: USD per container, charged when the vessel departs with nothing gated in.
- **No-show threshold**: the number of no-show fees across the customer's bookings in the trailing 90 days at which new requests for the tier are declined. The entry gate of each tier states the same figure as the count the customer must stay below.

## Tier table
| Tier | No-show fee (USD per container) | No-show threshold (fees in trailing 90 days) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 500.00 | 2 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 400.00 | 2 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 300.00 | 3 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 250.00 | 3 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 750.00 | 2 |
| AHL Premium Express | 900.00 | 2 |

## Hypothetical illustration
*Hypothetical customer, for illustration only:* a customer with two no-show fees in the trailing 90 days has reached the threshold of AHL Spot Saver, AHL Spot Flex, AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express, so new requests for those tiers are declined; the threshold of 3 for AHL Contract Booking and AHL Contract Priority has not been reached, so this figure does not by itself bar those two tiers. With one no-show fee, no tier's threshold is reached.

## Points of judgement
**Which tier has the highest no-show fee?** AHL Premium Express, at 900.00 per container; the lowest is AHL Contract Priority, at 250.00.
